## Exercises (sample)

1. A unit of work that must fully succeed or fully disappear.
2. All-or-nothing; keep valid rules; control concurrent visibility; keep committed data after failures.
3. A service method is the business use case and can coordinate multiple repositories cleanly.
4. Spring rolls the transaction back (default for runtime exceptions).

## Self-check

1. **False.** Spring coordinates the real database transaction.
2. **No.** Proxy-based TX normally needs public methods called through the proxy.
3. Debit and credit both happen, or neither does.
4. Starting / controlling a transaction boundary manually (begin work without auto-commit each statement).
